# dockercompose Provider

The `dockercompose` provider lets you manage Docker Compose stacks declaratively from Terraform. Instead of treating every container, network, and volume as a separate resource, a whole Compose stack is one Terraform resource — preserving Compose's native dependency graph, healthcheck-aware startup, and project isolation.

**Use cases:** homelab and self-hosted apps, edge / single-node production deployments over SSH, ephemeral CI/CD environments, dev environments as code, and migrating existing `docker-compose.yml` files into IaC without rewriting them.

**Two resource types:**

- [`dockercompose_stack`](resources/stack.md) — full HCL-modeled services, networks, volumes, configs, and secrets. Use this for new stacks where you want type-safe Terraform attributes.
- [`dockercompose_project`](resources/project.md) — point at an existing `docker-compose.yml` file or pass inline YAML. Use this to migrate legacy Compose files or generate YAML dynamically with `templatefile()`.

**Connection options:** local Docker socket (default), remote host via SSH (`ssh://user@host`), TCP with TLS (`tcp://host:2376`), or any value supported by the `DOCKER_HOST` environment variable.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    dockercompose = {
      source  = "ritajhq/dockercompose"
      version = "~> 1.1"
    }
  }
}

# Default configuration using local Docker instance
provider "dockercompose" {
  # (Optional) Defaults to the DOCKER_HOST environment variable if omitted.
  # host = "unix:///var/run/docker.sock"

  # (Optional) Provide a specific path to the docker executable.
  # docker_binary = "/usr/local/bin/docker"

  # (Optional) Override the base directory where docker-compose files and stack context will be saved.
  # project_directory = "/var/lib/terraform-docker-compose"

  # (Optional) Provider-level default for dockercompose_stack's `watch` attribute.
  # Individual stacks can still override this by setting `watch` explicitly, so a
  # single stack config can be reused across dev (watch = true) and other
  # environments (watch = false) just by toggling this — or a per-stack override.
  # watch = false

  # (Optional) Provider-level default for dockercompose_stack's `active_profiles`
  # attribute. Individual stacks can override this by setting `active_profiles`
  # explicitly (including [] to force no profiles active).
  # active_profiles = []
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `active_profiles` (List of String) Provider-level default for the dockercompose_stack `active_profiles` attribute. Individual stacks can override this by setting `active_profiles` explicitly.
- `docker_binary` (String) Path to the docker binary.
- `host` (String) Docker daemon host URL. Supports ssh://user@host, tcp://host:2376, unix:///path/to/socket. Defaults to DOCKER_HOST env var.
- `project_directory` (String) Base directory for storing generated docker-compose files. Defaults to ~/.terraform-docker-compose.
- `watch` (Boolean) Provider-level default for the dockercompose_stack `watch` attribute. Individual stacks can override this by setting `watch` explicitly.
